lines.t: What if helping others didn't always mean giving your money away?
In the United States, forty-one percent of people who hadn't donated said they couldn't afford to.
And nearly half of adults say feeling pressured discourages them from giving.
But good causes still need support.
What if kindness could grow a little differently?
Welcome to Hugshire.
A little world, with a lot of heart.
Where every supporter has a place, and every act of kindness helps a community grow.
Your journey begins with a deposit.
Behind the scenes, your deposit is designed to be lent through RHEA Finance on NEAR, earning variable interest.
As that yield adds up, heart-shaped fruits grow on your very own Heart Tree.
Harvest them, choose a cause, and deliver your support.
Or let your little helper deliver automatically, with your permission.
But there's a whole world beyond your tree.
Follow the roads, explore new towns, discover different causes, and meet the animals building them.
Every town represents a community worth supporting.
And here's where the fun begins!
Find an unfinished building.
Pick up an axe.
Time your chop...
Perfect!
Gather wood, help finish buildings, and watch your town come to life.
And while you're away, your helper can keep working too.
Little by little, everyone builds something together.
Every town has a story.
Visit the Notice Board to discover updates, photos, and progress shared by the organizations behind each cause.
Because the world beyond the game matters most.
There's another way to help, too.
Choose to watch an ad, and part of the revenue Hugshire receives can support the Community Heart Pool.
Eligible supporters share the charitable budget equally.
And each decides which approved cause it supports.
A little community effort, directed by the community itself.
And your deposit?
You can request your remaining funds back whenever you need them, subject to lending risks and withdrawal conditions.
Supporting a cause doesn't have to mean permanently giving away your savings.
Designed to feel as welcoming as any game.
Underneath, NEAR Intents carries your dollars onto NEAR, the Hugshire Vault lends them through RHEA, and every payout to a cause can be checked onchain.
A little world.
A community, growing together.
Hugshire.
Where kindness takes shape.
